title: KilpLAB
features:
Training
Auto Strength: Automatically performs training actions to gain strength.

Auto Rebirth: Automatically performs rebirths when target criteria are met.

Auto Speed: Automatically trains speed using treadmills.

Auto Eat Protein Egg: Automatically consumes "Protein Egg" items every 30 minutes.

Auto Fortune Wheel: Automatically spins the Fortune Wheel.

Auto Join Brawl: Continuously attempts to join brawls.

Auto Win Brawl: Continuously attempts to trigger win conditions in brawls.

Auto Chests: Automatically collects various rewards from in-game chests.

Auto Rock Farm: Automates the process of hitting selected "rocks" for durability/stats.

Combat
Kill Aura: Teleports to and automatically attacks selected players or everyone.

View Target: Sets the camera to focus on the selected kill target.

Auto Equip Punch: Ensures the "Punch" tool is equipped.

Auto Punch: Automatically performs punch actions.

Fast Punch: Increases the frequency of punch actions.

Recover Punch: A manual trigger to request the "Punch" tool from the server.

Defense
Anti Fling: Prevents the character from being flung by external forces.

Auto Dodge: Automatically moves the character to avoid other players.

No Punch Animation: Blocks/stops punch animations.

Freeze Self: Anchors or freezes the player's movement and velocity.

Travel
Teleport: Options to teleport to various specific gym locations.

Muscle Gym Auto TP: Automatically teleports to the Muscle King Gym.

Walk On Water: Creates platforms on water surfaces to allow walking.

Infinite Jump: Allows the player to jump infinitely in mid-air.

Noclip: Allows the player to move through walls/objects.

Remove Barriers: Deletes boundary/invisible wall parts.

Server Hop: Searches for and teleports the player to a different game server.

Rejoin: Teleports the player back into the same game instance.

Teleport To Random Player: Randomly selects and teleports to another player in the server.

Pets
Open Selected Crystal: Manually opens a specific type of crystal.

Auto Hatch: Automatically opens crystals until a desired pet is found.

Misc / GUI / Stats
Anti AFK: Keeps the player active to prevent being kicked for idling.

Player Stats: Displays real-time data for strength, rebirths, durability, agility, kills, and karma for selected players.

Stats Tracking: Calculates and displays rates of gain (per minute/hour/day) for stats.

ESP (Extra Sensory Perception): Highlights players and displays their distance and health.

Lag Switch: A toggle (F3) to introduce artificial network lag.

Timer & Stopwatch: Built-in tools for tracking time.

Remove Ad Portals: Deletes in-game advertising portals.

Anti Lag: Reduces part quality/textures in the workspace to improve performance.

Change Size: Modifies the character's size.

Menu Customization: Adjusts menu scale and max camera zoom
